scope: Read-only post-campaign diagnostic; cumulative statistics include fixture preparation and all trials, not measurement-specific.

data.normalized_query: WITH pgrst_source AS (INSERT INTO "public"."posts"("author", "body", "title") SELECT "pgrst_body"."author", "pgrst_body"."body", "pgrst_body"."title" FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "author", "body", "title" FROM json_to_recordset(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("author" uuid, "body" text, "title" text) ) pgrst_body  RETURNING "public"."posts"."id") SELECT $2 AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, array[]::text[] AS header, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $3) AS body, nullif(current_setting($4, $5), $6) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($7, $8), $9) AS response_status, $10 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "posts"."id" FROM "pgrst_source" AS "posts"   ) _postgrest_t

WITH pgrst_source AS (INSERT INTO "public"."likes"("post", "user") SELECT "pgrst_body"."post", "pgrst_body"."user" FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "post", "user" FROM json_to_recordset(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("post" uuid, "user" uuid) ) pgrst_body  RETURNING "public"."likes"."id") SELECT $2 AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, array[]::text[] AS header, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $3) AS body, nullif(current_setting($4, $5), $6) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($7, $8), $9) AS response_status, $10 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "likes"."id" FROM "pgrst_source" AS "likes"   ) _postgrest_t

WITH pgrst_source AS ( SELECT "public"."posts"."id", "public"."posts"."author", "public"."posts"."title", "public"."posts"."body", "public"."posts"."created_at", "public"."posts"."updated_at" FROM "public"."posts"  ORDER BY "public"."posts"."created_at" DESC , "public"."posts"."id" DESC  LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2 )  SELECT $3::bigint AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $4) AS body, nullif(current_setting($5, $6), $7) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($8, $9), $10) AS response_status, $11 AS response_inserted FROM ( SELECT * FROM pgrst_source ) _postgrest_t

INSERT INTO mfa_amr_claims(id, session_id, created_at, updated_at, authentication_method) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
			ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT mfa_amr_claims_session_id_authentication_method_pkey
			DO UPDATE SET updated_at = $6

select set_config('search_path', $1, true), set_config($2, $3, true), set_config('role', $4, true), set_config('request.jwt.claims', $5, true), set_config('request.method', $6, true), set_config('request.path', $7, true), set_config('request.headers', $8, true), set_config('request.cookies', $9, true)

WITH pgrst_source AS ( SELECT "public"."posts"."id", "public"."posts"."author", "public"."posts"."title", "public"."posts"."body", "public"."posts"."created_at", "public"."posts"."updated_at" FROM "public"."posts" WHERE  "public"."posts"."author" = $1   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3 ) , pgrst_source_count AS (SELECT $5  FROM "public"."posts" WHERE  "public"."posts"."author" = $4) SELECT (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pgrst_source_count) AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $6) AS body, nullif(current_setting($7, $8), $9) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($10, $11), $12) AS response_status, $13 AS response_inserted FROM ( SELECT * FROM pgrst_source ) _postgrest_t

WITH pgrst_source AS ( SELECT "public"."likes"."id", "public"."likes"."user", "public"."likes"."post" FROM "public"."likes"   LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2 ) , pgrst_source_count AS (SELECT $3  FROM "public"."likes") SELECT (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pgrst_source_count) AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $4) AS body, nullif(current_setting($5, $6), $7) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($8, $9), $10) AS response_status, $11 AS response_inserted FROM ( SELECT * FROM pgrst_source ) _postgrest_t

WITH pgrst_source AS (INSERT INTO "public"."likes"("post", "user") SELECT "pgrst_body"."post", "pgrst_body"."user" FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "post", "user" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("post" uuid, "user" uuid) ) pgrst_body  RETURNING "public"."likes"."id") SELECT $2 AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, array[]::text[] AS header, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t)->$3, $4) AS body, nullif(current_setting($5, $6), $7) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($8, $9), $10) AS response_status, $11 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "likes"."id" FROM "pgrst_source" AS "likes"   ) _postgrest_t
